Supported by an Open Educational Resources Faculty Grant at Northwestern (joint with Aaron
Greicius), this project added WeBWorK problems to a PreTeXt linear algebra OER textbook, so that
the text ships with a bank of auto-graded exercises attached to each section.

Free textbooks are only half the problem; free assessment is the other half.
